senses.sense_definition: A paten or salver used in the Eastern Christian rite of the Elevation of the Panagia to hold bread blessed in honor of the Virgin Mary.

examples.text: The monk carefully placed the blessed bread upon the silver <w>panagiarion</w> during the monastic meal.
In the monastery museum, an ornate <w>panagiarion</w> dating back to the Byzantine era was on display.
